arxiv-1812-05558.title: U-PoT: A Honeypot Framework for UPnP-Based IoT Devices
arxiv-1812-05558.creator: Muhammad A. Hakim, Hidayet Aksu, A. Selcuk Uluagac, Kemal Akkaya
arxiv-1812-05558.description: Abstract The ubiquitous nature of the IoT devices has brought serious security implications to its users. A lot of consumer IoT devices have little to no security implementation at all, thus risking user’s privacy and making them target of mass cyber-attacks.

arxiv-2011-14396.title: Confinement and moduli locking of Alice strings and monopoles
arxiv-2011-14396.creator: Muneto Nitta
arxiv-2011-14396.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Muneto Nitta. We argue that strings (vortices) and monopoles are confined, when fields receiving nontrivial Aharonov-Bohm (AB) phases around a string develop vacuum expectation values (VEVs). We illustrate this in an S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) × U ⁡ ( 1 ) SU(2)\times U(1) gauge theory with charged triplet complex scalar fields admitting Alice strings and monopoles, by introducing charged doublet scalar fields receiving nontrivial AB phases around the Alice string.

arxiv-2101-12103.title: Bilinear control and growth of Sobolev norms for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2101-12103.creator: Alessandro Duca, Vahagn Nersesyan
arxiv-2101-12103.description: Abstract We consider the nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLS) on a torus of arbitrary dimension. The equation is studied in presence of an external potential field whose time-dependent amplitude is taken as control. Assuming that the potential satisfies a saturation property, we show that the NLS equation is approximately controllable between any pair of eigenstates in arbitrarily small time.

arxiv-2105-07927.title: Strong constraints on Lorentz violation using new γ \gamma -ray observations around PeV
arxiv-2105-07927.creator: Liang Chen 1,2,3, Zheng Xiong 1,2,3, Cong Li 1,3, SongZhan Chen 1,3, HuiHai He 1,2,3
arxiv-2105-07927.description: Abstract The tiny modification of dispersion relation induced by Lorentz violation (LV) is an essential issue in quantum gravity (QG) theories, which can be magnified into significant effects when dealing with astrophysical observations at high energy and long propagation distance.

arxiv-2105-10585.title: Properties of the After Kernel
arxiv-2105-10585.creator: Philip M. Long
arxiv-2105-10585.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Philip M. Long. The Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) is the wide-network limit of a kernel defined using neural networks at initialization, whose embedding is the gradient of the output of the network with respect to its parameters. We study the “after kernel”, which is defined using the same embedding, except after training, for neural networks with standard architectures, on binary classification problems extracted from MNIST and CIFAR-10, trained using SGD in a standard way.

arxiv-2209-01889.title: Quantifying nanoscale charge density features of contact-charged surfaces with an FEM/KPFM-hybrid approach
arxiv-2209-01889.creator: Felix Pertl, Juan Carlos Sobarzo, Lubuna Shafeek, Tobias Cramer, Scott Waitukaitis
arxiv-2209-01889.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Felix Pertl, Juan Carlos Sobarzo, Lubuna Shafeek, Tobias Cramer, Scott Waitukaitis. Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) is a powerful tool for studying contact electrification (CE) at the nanoscale, but converting KPFM voltage maps to charge density maps is non-trivial due to long-range forces and complex system geometry. Here we present a strategy using finite element method (FEM) simulations to determine the Green’s function of the KPFM probe/insulator/ground system, which allows us to quantitatively extract surface charge.

arxiv-2309-12475.title: Dissecting the Thermal SZ Power Spectrum by Halo Mass and Redshift in SPT-SZ Data and Simulations
arxiv-2309-12475.creator: Josemanuel Hernández, Lindsey Bleem, Thomas Crawford, Nicholas Huang, Yuuki Omori, Srinivasan Raghunathan, Christian Reichardt
arxiv-2309-12475.description: Abstract We explore the relationship between the thermal Sunyaev-Zel’dovich (tSZ) power spectrum amplitude and the halo mass and redshift of galaxy clusters in South Pole Telescope (SPT) data, in comparison with three N N -body simulations combined with semi-analytical gas models of the intra-cluster medium.

arxiv-2312-08502.title: Leveraging commuting groups for an efficient variational Hamiltonian ansatz
arxiv-2312-08502.creator: Abhinav Anand, Kenneth R. Brown
arxiv-2312-08502.description: Abstract Efficiently calculating the low-lying eigenvalues of Hamiltonians, written as sums of Pauli operators, is a fundamental challenge in quantum computing. While various methods have been proposed to reduce the complexity of quantum circuits for this task, there remains room for further improvement.

arxiv-2404-01622.title: Gen4DS: Workshop on Data Storytelling in an Era of Generative AI
arxiv-2404-01622.creator: Xingyu Lan Fudan University, Leni Yang Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Zezhong Wang Simon Fraser University, Yun Wang Microsoft Research Asia, Danqing Shi Aalto University, Sheelagh Carpendale Simon Fraser University
arxiv-2404-01622.description: Abstract Storytelling is an ancient and precious human ability that has been rejuvenated in the digital age. Over the last decade, there has been a notable surge in the recognition and application of data storytelling, both in academia and industry. Recently, the rapid development of generative AI has brought new opportunities and challenges to this field, sparking numerous new questions.

arxiv-2404-09293.title: A Novel State Space Model with Local Enhancement and State Sharing for Image Fusion
arxiv-2404-09293.creator: Zihan Cao, Xiao Wu, Liang-Jian Deng, Yu Zhong
arxiv-2404-09293.description: Abstract . In image fusion tasks, images from different sources possess distinct characteristics. This has driven the development of numerous methods to explore better ways of fusing them while preserving their respective characteristics. Mamba, as a state space model, has emerged in the field of natural language processing. Recently, many studies have attempted to extend Mamba to vision tasks.

arxiv-2510-25752.title: Meshless solutions of PDE inverse problems on irregular geometries
arxiv-2510-25752.creator: James V. Roggeveen, Michael P. Brenner
arxiv-2510-25752.description: Abstract Solving inverse and optimization problems over solutions of nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) on complex spatial domains is a long-standing challenge. Here we introduce a method that parameterizes the solution using spectral bases on arbitrary spatiotemporal domains, whereby the basis is defined on a hyperrectangle containing the true domain.

pmc-10585218.title: The relationships between amotivation, employee engagement, introjected regulation, and intrinsic motivation: A double-layered moderated-mediation model
pmc-10585218.creator: Vijayakumar Gajenderan, Nishad Nawaz, Raman Rangarajan, Satyanarayana Parayitam
pmc-10585218.description: The objective of this research is to examine the amotivation-turnover intention relationship through self-determination theory (SDT). A double-layered moderated-mediation model was developed to investigate the influence of three components: affective, continuance, and normative commitment on turnover intention. The data collected from 771 faculty members from higher educational institutions (HEI) in southern India were analyzed to test the hypothesized relationships.

pmc-10628773.title: Travel-related giardiasis: incidence and time trends for various destination countries
pmc-10628773.creator: Franziska Hommes, Achim Dörre, Susanne C Behnke, Klaus Stark, Mirko Faber
pmc-10628773.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundGiardiasis is a common gastrointestinal illness in travellers. Data on the actual giardiasis risk of travellers to different travel destinations are scarce. We aim to estimate the risk of giardiasis in travellers from Germany by destination country and region.MethodsWe analysed travel-related giardiasis cases, their countries and regions of exposure and the age and sex distribution of cases reported in 2014–19 in Germany. We defined a travel-related giardiasis case as a laboratory-confirmed (i.e.

pmc-10661907.title: Osteoclasts in Osteosarcoma: Mechanisms, Interactions, and Therapeutic Prospects
pmc-10661907.creator: Yi-Ming Gao, Yan Pei, Fei-Fei Zhao, Ling Wang
pmc-10661907.description: Osteosarcoma is an extremely malignant tumor, and its pathogenesis is complex and remains incompletely understood. Most cases of osteosarcoma are accompanied by symptoms of bone loss or result in pathological fractures due to weakened bones. Enhancing the survival rate of osteosarcoma patients has proven to be a long-standing challenge.

pmc-10694323.title: Community pharmacists’ knowledge and awareness about isotretinoin therapy and its dispensing practice in Jordan
pmc-10694323.creator: Anan S. Jarab, Sayer I. Al-Azzam, Shriefa Al-Mutairi, Shrouq Abu Heshmeh, Tareq L. Mukattash, Walid AL-Qerem, Rami Beiram, Salah Aburuz
pmc-10694323.description: A validated self-reported questionnaire was used to evaluate pharmacists' knowledge about isotretinoin and their awareness of isotretinoin dispensing practice. The majority were not able to recognize the initial dose of isotretinoin, the potential side effects such as dyslipidemia and liver toxicity, the potential interaction with tetracycline and Vitamin A and the contraindications of isotretinoin. pmc-11436247.title: A Genetic Study of Spillovers in the Bean Common Mosaic Subgroup of Potyviruses
pmc-11436247.creator: Mohammad Hajizadeh, Karima Ben Mansour, Adrian J. Gibbs
pmc-11436247.description: Nine viruses of the bean common mosaic virus subgroup of potyviruses are major international crop pathogens, but their phylogenetically closest relatives from non-crop plants have mostly been found only in SE Asia and Oceania, which is thus likely to be their “centre of emergence”.

pmc-11479484.title: Intrafocal Pinning in Distal Extraarticular Radius Fracture: A Retrospective Study Based on Patient Age
pmc-11479484.creator: Abdulaziz Asiry, Jean Baptiste De Villeneuve Bargemon, Stéphanie Delclaux, Pierre Mansat, Silvia Gandolfi, Elise Lupon
pmc-11479484.description: Background:Percutaneous intrafocal pinning is one of the many surgical options for extraarticular distal radius fracture with minimal comminution. This study aims to describe the role and indications of intrafocal pinning.Methods:This monocentric, retrospective study included 49 patients who underwent intrafocal pinning for distal radius fractures in 2013 in our French hand surgery department.

pmc-11537913.title: The evolution of psychotherapy: from Freud to prescription digital therapeutics
pmc-11537913.creator: John P. Docherty, Brett M. Colbert
pmc-11537913.description: The evolution of psychotherapeutic treatments from Freud to digitally administered evidence-based treatments reflects a history of progressive advance. This history is characterized by identification of problems with the current state of the art, followed by solutions inspired and supported by advances in basic science and technology leading to subsequent recognition of other limitations revealed by the new advance.

pmc-11689737.title: MEDICARE ENROLLEES WITH COMPLEX HEALTH NEEDS FROM PUERTO RICO
pmc-11689737.creator: Maricruz Rivera-Hernandez, Matthew Campos
pmc-11689737.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Older adults in Puerto Rico have higher rates of chronic conditions and poverty rates compared to adults in the US mainland (Matos-Moreno et al., 2022; U.S. Census Bureau, 2019). In addition, the island of Puerto Rico has faced unique challenges related to infrastructure damages as a result of Hurricane Maria in 2017 (Florido, 2020), and further continues to face disparities in quality of care for older adult populations (Rivera-Hernandez et al., 2021).

pmc-12413432.title: Effect of host movement on the prevalence of vector-borne diseases
pmc-12413432.creator: Daozhou Gao, Yuan Lou
pmc-12413432.description: Human movement plays a key role in spreading vector-borne diseases globally. Various spatial models of vector-borne diseases have been proposed and analyzed, mainly focusing on disease dynamics. In this paper, based on a multi-patch Ross–Macdonald model, we study the impact of host migration on the local and global host disease prevalences.

pmc-12512814.title: Enhancement of shared decision-making competencies in diabetes care using the BOPPPS model: a training program design for general practitioners
pmc-12512814.creator: Hongyan Song, Panpan Feng, Kai Lin, Xiaoning Han, Xiting Wang, Mi Yao
pmc-12512814.description: BackgroundDiabetes mellitus is one of the most prevalent chronic diseases worldwide. China has the highest number of diabetic cases worldwide. However, diabetes mellitus is associated with poor awareness, treatment, and control rates. Thus, strategies such as shared decision-making (SDM) are needed to improve diabetes management. In China, SDM training tailored for general practitioners (GPs) is limited, hindering its clinical application.

pmc-12546895.title: Combating Gram-negative infections: The role of antimicrobial peptides and nanotechnology in overcoming antibiotic resistance
pmc-12546895.creator: Christian S Carnero Canales, Jessica Ingrid Marquez Cazorla, Renzo Marianito Marquez Cazorla, Rafael Miguel Sábio, Hélder A Santos, Fernando Rogério Pavan
pmc-12546895.description: Gram-negative bacterial infections represent a critical global health threat due to rising antibiotic resistance, posing substantial clinical and economic burdens. The structural complexity of Gram-negative bacteria—including efflux pumps, enzymatic degradation mechanisms, genetic mutations, and altered membrane permeability, significantly complicates treatment with conventional antibiotics. Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) offer great antimicrobial activity, rapid bactericidal effects, multiple mechanisms of action, and immune-modulatory properties.

pmc-12616899.title: Body talk and the internalization of the ideal body image: examination based on the tripartite influence model
pmc-12616899.creator: Nahori Ito, Akira Hasegawa, Masaki Adachi, Shin-ichi Oura, Tetsuya Yamamoto, Yuko Matsuda, Takuro Tomita
pmc-12616899.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundBased on the tripartite influence model, this longitudinal study investigated the relationship between body talk and the internalization of ideal body images, mainly focusing on female university students. It was hypothesized that negative fat talk and positive body talk would interact with exposure to thin-ideal images on the internet to influence the internalization of the thin ideal, leading to body fat dissatisfaction among women.

pmc-12788477.title: Association Between Serum Vitamin D Levels and Glycemic Status in Prediabetic Adults
pmc-12788477.creator: Nitin Wathore, Dibyanshu, Samreen Farooqui, Tanvi Patel, Sangeeta Gupta, Mayur N. Vasava
pmc-12788477.description: Background:Vitamin D is very important for insulin secretion and sensitivity, and not getting enough of it has been related to problems with glucose metabolism. Prediabetes is a stage of glucose intolerance that can be reversed. Finding modifiable risk factors, such as a lack of vitamin D, can aid with early intervention.

pmc-12996241.title: Differential effects of non-selective and cardio-selective beta-blocker therapy on ECG parameters in long QT syndrome type 1
pmc-12996241.creator: Marina Rieder, Vanessa Christe, Saranda Nimani, Peter M. Deissler, Rachel M.A. ter Bekke, Katja E. Odening
pmc-12996241.description: Highlights•Non-selective β-blockers markedly reduce Tpeak/end in LQT1 patients.•Cardio-selective β-blockers show no consistent effect on Tpeak/end.•The nsBB effect persists after exercise, independent of heart rate.•Tpeak/end shortening indicates decreased global repolarization heterogeneity and reduced arrhythmic risk.•Tpeak/end may serve as a novel ECG marker for β-blocker efficacy in LQT1.

pmc-13096148.title: Bird-inspired optimization approach using taper-shape transfer function for intrusion detection in IoT networks
pmc-13096148.creator: Celal Can
pmc-13096148.description: The Internet of Things (IoT) has emerged as a pervasive technological paradigm that interconnects heterogeneous devices and sensors, enabling continuous data acquisition, communication, and intelligent decision-making. However, the large-scale, dynamic, and heterogeneous nature of IoT environments introduces significant cybersecurity threats, making intrusion detection a critical component of IoT network protection.

pmc-13503534.creator: Yue Zhong, Yiyang Ren, Jiayin Zhang, Jialei Liu, Yuguang Zheng, Dan Zhang, Lei Wang, Long Guo
